settingLabels.customer_notifications.ena: Switches the notification centre in the buyer's account on or off. Nothing is deleted while it is off.
settingLabels.customer_notifications.ret: How many days a notification stays in the buyer's account before it is deleted. From 7 to 730 days.
module.name: Customer notifications
module.description: A notification centre in the buyer's storefront account: entries other modules record for one customer account, read, counted and marked read through the storefront API, and deleted after a retention period.
